title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease End-of-Term Hold Payment
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — hold payments on an overdue end-of-term balance**

**What a hold payment is.** A hold payment is the lessee's own payment toward the end-of-term balance of a lease whose end-of-term invoice's due date — its mailing date plus the end-of-term payment period — passed more than the hold-start day count earlier and on which no end-of-term payment has posted since that invoice was mailed. It is made by the lessee through the self-service payment line from the lessee's own bank account and is booked as one end-of-term payment.

**When it is offered.** A lessee who asks to keep such a lease from being charged off without paying the whole balance is offered the hold payment. A lease outside that scope is outside this rule.

**Effect on charge-off.** For a lease whose end-of-term balance receives a hold payment, and only for such a lease, the balance left after the hold payment is not charged off until the hold period has run, counted in calendar days after the hold payment posts. A balance enrolled in a lease-end installment plan never receives a hold payment and is charged off as the installment plan rule states, and every other end-of-term balance still unpaid at the end of the tier's end-of-term charge-off period after the turn-in date is charged off.

**When the amount is fixed.** The hold payment is fixed only after every excess wear charge billed for the turn-in carries the wear forgiveness waiver owed on it. While any excess wear charge of the turn-in stands on the lease without the wear forgiveness waiver owed on it, the hold payment amount is not yet fixed.

**Reading the invoice.** Where the lease has more than one end-of-term invoice, the latest mailing date is read.

| Lease situation | Hold payment |
|---|---|
| Invoice due date passed more than the hold-start day count earlier; no end-of-term payment since the invoice was mailed; lessee asks to avoid charge-off without paying in full | offered |
| An end-of-term payment has posted since the invoice was mailed | outside this rule |
| Balance enrolled in a lease-end installment plan | never receives a hold payment |

---

**Self-service tool: `pay_end_of_term_hold_a939b773`**

*Capability.* The lessee pays a hold payment on the unpaid end-of-term balance of the lessee's own Kestrel closed-end lease through the self-service payment line, drawn by ACH from the lessee's own bank account. One run posts one payment entry against end-of-term charges on the lease's posting history and lowers the lease's end-of-term balance by the amount paid. The lessee hears a confirmation with the payment reference and the balance still owed.

*How it is invoked.* This is the lessee's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_end_of_term_hold_a939b773` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

*Parameters*

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lease_contract_id` | the reference number of the lessee's lease record, as given to the lessee by the representative from the lease lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the payment amount in USD | positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `funding_account_last4` | the last four digits of the lessee's own bank account the payment is drawn from; the lessee states them | 4 digits, or empty when the lessee names no account |

*Return.* A receipt with `payment_id` (reference number of the posted payment), `lease_contract_id`, `amount` (USD paid, 2 decimal places), `payment_channel` (always `phone_ivr_ach`), `end_of_term_balance` (USD left owed on the lease-end account net of the payment, 2 decimal places) and `status` (`posted` when the payment is on the account).
